name: WRITING GUIDELINES
summary: 80+ rule technical writing and docs audit from Vercel: voice, structure, content types, headings, lists, code samples, placeholders, typography, and AI workflow accountability.
prevents: Vague, passive, filler-heavy documentation — banned words like 'easy/simple/quick', missing TL;DR opens, mismatched content type tone, and broken code sample conventions.

cursor.rule_description: Use when writing or reviewing documentation, READMEs, changelogs, how-to guides, reference pages, or any technical prose.
